definitions.explanation: A violent disturbance by a group of people, typically directed against authority or in protest. Composed of 暴 (violence) + 動 (movement). Used in news reporting and historical contexts.

examples.japanese: {暴動|ぼうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暴動|ぼうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{暴動|ぼうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: A food shortage triggered a large-scale uprising.

notes:
USAGE:
{暴動|ぼうどう} refers to violent collective action, typically against the government or authorities. It is a formal, news-register word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴動|ぼうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ / ⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (a riot breaks out)
- {暴動|ぼうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to suppress a riot)
- {暴動|ぼうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧ (to develop into a riot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧ refers to a peaceful demonstration or protest, while {暴動|ぼうどう} specifically implies violence. ⟦{反乱|はんらん}→反乱：11860_hanran⟧ is a broader term for rebellion, often with organized military opposition.
